text:
Letter from the pretend river-post club:
Our Foam Barges are also called cloud ferries; these names refer to the same toy.
For Foam Barges, do not dispatch a parcel if the stamp is missing.
Dispatch with a stamp is conditional on the envelope being dry.
P.S. A damp envelope may travel only inside a blue sleeve; this exception qualifies dispatch.
A higher dryness rating means a lower blur tendency, not a higher one.
One note calls the sleeve blue; a second calls its colour unknown. Do not resolve the disagreement.
The club-wide bell closes all desks after the final verse.

Annex: unrelated counter game
Scope: Pebble Counters
Aliases: stone tabs
Keep Pebble Counters under the woven cover until noon.
